scientific.integrity: The displayed source objective is transformed exactly under arbitrary positive task rescaling. The transformed objective differs only by a constant, giving exact equality of model and log-variance gradients and a trajectory conjugacy for translation-equivariant first-order optimizers.
limitations: Fixed positive multiplicative task-loss scale factors.
Shifted log-variance initialization is required for exact trajectory matching.
Weight decay, clipping, or constraints on uncertainty parameters break optimizer-level conjugacy.
The classification term is the source simplified approximation.

title: Uncertainty weighting has an exact loss-unit gauge symmetry
